# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** the "rose-red" girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is described as a striking, dark-eyed girl who won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's. She is also referred to as the "rose-red" girl.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart brimming with light, multicolored yearning dreams and imaginations. Although she can experience periods of weariness and despondency regarding her studies and teaching duties, she is deeply close to her friends and values autonomous, shared living.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)_

## Traits

- Striking and dark-eyed  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Imaginative and dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Prone to occasional melancholy  <sub>[v3 c35 P30](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0030), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching across multiple grades  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To leave rural schoolteaching and attend Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- To lease a house in Portmaris with Nell and Honora for their college years  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- To write a paper titled 'The Trials of a Country Schoolmarm'  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## History

While attending Regent's Academy, Mabel became part of a close circle of contemplative, creative scholars alongside Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis, winning the Second Year beauty prize. After completing her studies at Regent's, she worked for several years as a country schoolteacher instructing nine grades. Wearying of rural teaching and the misperceptions of her work, she planned to attend Wexcombe College by entering the Sophomore class. She wrote to Nell proposing that they, along with Honora, lease a small house in Portmaris with her Aunt Euphemia as their housekeeper. The plan succeeded, and she moved into Tabby's Place to pursue her final year at Wexcombe.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- Taught continuously in an isolated rural schoolhouse after completing Regent's  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
